package.description: Widget dashboard for the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE display, or a bar on any screen edge

en-US.description: Widget dashboard for the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE display, or a bar on any screen edge
en-US.longDescription:
RedXe is a native Windows dashboard for the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE: pages of widgets on its 2560x720 touch canvas,
or a fixed or auto-hiding bar on the edge of any monitor. Bundled widgets include Matrix Rain and a shader
slideshow, desk and studio clocks, CPU, memory, GPU, network, storage, power, and thermal meters, a process
viewer, weather, an application launcher, AV controls, and services for the Logitech MX Creative Console and
Zoom meetings. Swipe with two fingers or roll the mouse wheel to change pages; edit the JSON settings file while
it runs and the dashboard applies the change at once.
en-US.name: RedXe
